notes: A much better Flashlight: a bright round hotspot with a soft wider glow around it, from the flashlight in your hand rather than your eyes, fading with distance and stopping at walls.
Other players' flashlights now show as a faint beam in the air, and you see the glare of the lens when one points at you.
Works with shader packs: with Iris on, the beam lights the world in the pack's own lighting, and a lit flashlight counts as held light.
